citations.assessment: The retrieved Berakhot version gives bracketed Gedilah, brother of R. Abba bar Kohen, transmitting in Aḥa’s name. Aḥa denies having said it later in the same scene; preserve the exact original report and distinguish the variant spelling.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

citations.assessment: The Nazir parallel reads Gevilah and calls him brother of R. Ba bar Kohen. The two loci differ in the shape of the name, while the chain and later disavowal match.
